title: Zero Power Behavior: BRAKE vs FLOAT

hints.title: Which motors to reverse
hints.content: On a standard mecanum drivetrain the left motors face opposite to the right motors. Reverse `frontLeft` and `backLeft`: `frontLeft.setDirection(DcMotor.Direction.REVERSE);`

hints.title: Setting BRAKE behavior
hints.content: Call `motor.setZeroPowerBehavior(DcMotor.ZeroPowerBehavior.BRAKE);` on each motor. This makes the motor actively resist movement when power is 0 — important for drivetrains that need to hold position.

hints.title: Mecanum power equations
hints.content: The four equations are: `fl = drive + strafe + rotate`, `fr = drive - strafe - rotate`, `bl = drive - strafe + rotate`, `br = drive + strafe - rotate`. These can exceed ±1.0 if multiple inputs are combined — add normalization for production code.
